subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot recap & next steps — token volumes / pricing

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet you and Bob. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Pilot scope: embed + summarize flow for customer support tickets (~1–2M tokens/week expected during pilot).
- Goal: validate latency and unit economics at scale; target pricing window you mentioned: $30–$50 per 1M tokens (net) to be competitive for your internal cost goals.
- Key success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for classify/embed path, and cost <= $40/1M tokens across production mix.

Follow-ups / asks for Acme:
1) Confirm expected weekly token burn (rough estimate ok). You mentioned ~1.2M tokens/week steady-state, spikes to 2M during peak.
2) Procurement: point-of-contact for contract/PO (copied)
3) Approval for a 2-week trial extension and additional free credits — see below.

Pilot credits proposal from Redwood:
- We can extend the pilot by 2 weeks and add 1,000,000 free token credits to help cover ramp and give you headroom to test peak scenarios.
- Conditional ask: we’ll do a quick burn-rate check at the end of week 1 (simple usage CSV) to ensure the extension covers realistic load.

Attachments: pilot_agreement_v2.pdf (proposed extension language) — small edits only; acme_week1_usage_report.csv is sample template we’ll use for the burn check.

Next steps:
- If you confirm the token estimates and procurement contact, I’ll route the credits approval and send updated DocuSign for signature.
- Neha (CC) will schedule a 30-min check-in at end of week 1 to review usage.

Thanks — available for a quick sync if anything needs clarifying.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Alice Johnson <alice@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot recap & next steps — token volumes / pricing

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Quick answers: 

- Token estimate: we expect ~1.3M tokens/week initially, rising to ~1.9–2.1M in peak test days. The flow is about 70% embeddings + 30% long-form summarization.
- Target cost: ideally we want to be <= $35/1M tokens blended. If we can get effective unit economics around $30–35/1M, we’ll be able to justify expanding after pilot.
- Procurement POC: procurement@acme.com (looping them in).

On the credits: 1,000,000 free token credits sounds great and should cover our first-week ramp. We’d like the two-week extension to include the burn-rate check you mentioned.

I’m attaching the first-week usage export from our internal staging run (see inline below) — this is small but should give you a sense of per-call size.

On schedule, Bob and I are available for the week-1 check on Aug 9–10.

Appreciate the flexibility — please send the updated agreement.

Best,
Alice
Head of AI Product, Acme Corp
alice@acme.com

Date: 2027-08-03T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot recap & next steps — token volumes / pricing

Alice — great, thanks for the fast clarification and the staging export. Based on the numbers you provided (1.3M steady -> ~2M peak) I’ve approved the pilot extension and credit grant internally. Details below: 

Approved items:
- Pilot extension: +14 days (new end date: 2027-08-21)
- Free token credits: 1,000,000 Redwood token credits applied to your account (visible in Console under Billing > Credits).
- Conditional check: Neha will run the week-1 burn check on Aug 9 and confirm whether we need to top-up credits to cover peak tests.

Notes on pricing / unit economics: 
- Public benchmark: our mid-tier text/generation models are roughly $X/1M tokens list; for your blended mix we can target $30–$40/1M depending on model selection & quantization.
- If Acme is targeting <= $35/1M blended, we’ll put that on the success criteria list for expansion. We can also run a quick post-pilot cost breakdown showing per-route unit economics so you can model run-rate spend.

I’ve attached the updated pilot_agreement_v2.pdf (minor language for extension) and started a DocuSign envelope for the extension (link below). Once procurement signs, the credits will be applied immediately.

Related links: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ACME-PILOT-EXT-2027

If it helps, Rishi (cc) can join the week-1 check to discuss cost levers (batching/quantization/routing) if we see costs above target.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: pilot_agreement_v2.pdf

From: Alice Johnson <alice@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot recap & next steps — token volumes / pricing

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the credit grant. Procurement will review and sign the extension today.

I’ve scheduled the week-1 check-in for Aug 9 at 10:00am PT (invitation sent to Neha and Rishi). We’ll upload the staging export and connect logs so you can run the initial burn-rate analysis.

If we hit peak numbers in that window and need more credits, I’ll flag it immediately. Otherwise, we’ll proceed and circle back after the check.

Best,
Alice
